recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-9982 unless Pharmacy later reopens the broader set of summary elements for the current MedicationStatement resource.
issue_request: FHIR-9982 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy change request asking that MedicationStatement retain summary flags for status, medication, patient, effective[x], wasNotTaken, and dateAsserted.
initial_application: Historical commit 2df711bee7ad56d7df9aef20f8c483a9bcc56ce8 explicitly mentioned 9982 and added summary markers to the old MedicationStatement spreadsheet source for the requested fields. That spreadsheet is no longer the current build source.
additional_context: MedicationStatement is active in source/fhir.ini and now uses source/medicationstatement/structuredefinition-MedicationStatement.xml. The old patient element is now MedicationStatement.subject, and later Published Pharmacy issues FHIR-19468 and FHIR-19470 moved not-taken/taken semantics into MedicationStatement.adherence; FHIR-38682 restored the MedicationStatement name after the MedicationUsage interval while preserving that redesign.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current StructureDefinition marks status, medication, subject, effective[x], dateAsserted, adherence, and adherence.code as summary, so the original request is represented in the current model. Reintroducing obsolete patient/wasNotTaken/notTaken elements or removing unrelated later summary flags would be incorrect.
